files.note: Departamento de la Vivienda, "Refugios Temporada de Huracanes 2026" (PDF, 19 pages, text via pdftotext -layout). Columns in the document: municipio, facility, address, Google Maps link; it gives no capacities, so capacity is absent. 343 shelters. facility_type is read from the name's first words (Esc. = school, Centro Comunal = community centre, ...). Coordinates, where present (332 of 343), come from the Google Maps link printed in the list: the short link is followed and the coordinates are read from the resolved URL; a point more than 25 km from the municipio's internal point is discarded. Listed schools are also matched by name to OpenStreetMap schools in the same municipio (data/osm/facilities.json generated 2026-10-10T05:04:11.850Z): names are normalised (case, accents, Esc./Escuela/S.U./level words dropped), score = mean of Jaccard and containment of the remaining name tokens, accepted at score >= 0.7 with at least two shared tokens, a clear lead over the next candidate and, where the list's map link gave a point, within 2 km of it: 229 housed_at links with the score as confidence. A shelter without a usable map link takes the matched school's coordinates (4). Shelters located neither way have no coordinates (location_basis "not located"). municipio.shelters = shelters listed per municipio.
